description: Sets the column's value by extracting a capture group from a regex pattern applied to a source column.

sourceColumnName.description: The name of the column to read the value from (e.g., 'fileName').

pattern.description: The regular expression to apply. Must include at least one capture group (e.g., 'site-\d+/(\w+)/.*').

groupIndex.description: The 1-based index of the capture group to extract.

onMatchFailure.description: Action to take if the regex does not match the source value. Default SET_NULL.
onMatchFailure.name: OnMatchFailure
